20.source_text: Son of God, the Firstborn—“I will go and redeem the human family upon the conditions that thou hast devised.” But how could he go and redeem them? He could not redeem them, unless he suffered for them and in their behalf. The penalty of death had passed upon them. His father might have reasoned with him in words something like these—If you, a pure sinless being, my only begotten Son, are willing…
